sponsor: Leads Biolabs (Nanjing Leads Biolabs Co., Ltd.)
mechanism: PD-L1/4-1BB bispecific antibody (PD-L1 blockade plus PD-L1-crosslinked 4-1BB agonism)
indications: extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma|neuroendocrine carcinoma|small cell lung cancer|non-small cell lung cancer|ovarian cancer|melanoma|biliary tract cancer|advanced solid tumors
latest_data: ASCO 2025 (abstract 2500): LBL-024 + etoposide/platinum in treatment-naive advanced extrapulmonary NEC, ORR 75% (n=52), 83.3% ORR and 100% DCR at the 15 mg/kg dose. ASCO 2024 (abstract 4010): monotherapy in later-line NEC roughly doubled ORR and OS vs historical benchmarks. Single-arm pivotal trial in EP-NEC ongoing since July 2024.
first_in_class_note: Reported as the first 4-1BB-targeted agent globally to reach pivotal stage; FDA Fast Track and Orphan Drug designations (NEC) and CDE Breakthrough Therapy Designation (EP-NEC).
notes: Highest phase recorded as phase 2 because the registrational EP-NEC study is a single-arm pivotal Phase 2; no out-licensing found (rights assumed retained). NDA status not verified.

mechanism: BCMA/CD3 T-cell-engaging bispecific antibody
indications: relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma|high-risk smoldering multiple myeloma|dynamically high-risk multiple myeloma|immune thrombocytopenia|pemphigus|bullous pemphigoid|AL amyloidosis|POEMS syndrome
latest_data: ASH 2024 (NCT05299424, R/R MM, median follow-up 8.0 mo): confirmed ORR 60.9% (14/23) overall and 100% (8/8) in the 80/160 mg target-dose cohorts; sCR 43.5%; MRD-negativity 88.9% (8/9) at 10^-5; median time to response 1.4 mo. First Phase 3 (RRMM after >=2 prior lines, n=280, CM336 vs investigator's choice) registered Sept 2025; Phase 2 studies in autoimmune indications (ITP, pemphigus, bullous pemphigoid) recruiting.
notes: INN 'gamgertamig' inferred from the Synapse drug page returned for the CM336 query; verify. No ex-China licensing found.

mechanism: CLDN18.2-directed ADC with topoisomerase-1 inhibitor payload
indications: CLDN18.2-positive HER2-negative gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma|pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma|advanced solid tumors
latest_data: Phase 3 G-HOPE-001 (NCT06238843; n=464, China/Japan; previously treated CLDN18.2+ HER2- G/GEJ adenocarcinoma, monotherapy vs investigator's choice) met its primary endpoint at the first interim analysis (2025) and the NDA was accepted by NMPA for later-line CLDN18.2+ gastric cancer. ASCO 2025 oral: Phase 1 in CLDN18.2+ advanced pancreatic cancer showed durable efficacy with matured PFS/OS; Phase 3 in 1L pancreatic cancer planned in China. Phase 1 G/GEJ data published in Nature Medicine (2025). FDA Fast Track for 2L+ PDAC.
first_in_class_note: Among the first CLDN18.2 ADCs to reach registrational stage; FDA Fast Track (pancreatic cancer).
notes: Described by Fierce Biotech as 'Takeda-partnered' following the Oct 2025 Innovent-Takeda collaboration (Takeda holds an option/partnership on ex-China rights); exact territory terms not verified. Approval status after NDA acceptance not verified.

mechanism: biparatopic anti-HER2 bispecific ADC with topoisomerase-1 inhibitor payload (site-specific glycan conjugation)
indications: HER2-positive breast cancer|HER2-low breast cancer|platinum-resistant ovarian cancer|HER2-positive colorectal cancer|HER2-expressing gastrointestinal tumors|advanced solid tumors
latest_data: Phase 3 in 2L HER2-positive breast cancer completed enrollment with an NDA expected in 2026; Phase 3 in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (JSKN003-306) dosing since Feb 2025 and a Phase 3 in HER2-low breast cancer initiated. ESMO 2024 pooled analysis in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (n=27) and ASCO/ESMO 2025 updates reported promising ORR with favorable safety across PROC, HER2+ breast cancer and HER2-expressing GI tumors. CDE Breakthrough Therapy Designations including HER2-positive advanced colorectal cancer.
first_in_class_note: Biparatopic HER2 ADC positioned as a potential best-in-class successor to T-DXd.
notes: No INN found. Ex-China licensing status not verified.

mechanism: dual orexin receptor antagonist (DORA)
indications: insomnia disorder
latest_data: World Sleep 2025 (Singapore): Phase 3 randomized placebo-controlled trial in insomnia disorder (NCT05525637) showed rapid onset and significant improvement after 14 days in polysomnography objective sleep parameters and sleep-diary subjective measures; a second Phase 3 in primary chronic insomnia (NCT06680505) ongoing. First-in-human PK/PD study published 2025 (PMC12184692).
first_in_class_note: Class 1 innovative DORA developed in China.
notes: NDA status not verified.

mechanism: PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific antibody (dual immune checkpoint inhibitor)
indications: cervical cancer|gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma|hepatocellular carcinoma|esophageal squamous cell carcinoma|biliary tract cancer|colorectal cancer liver metastases|non-small cell lung cancer
latest_data: NMPA approved 1L cervical cancer (all-comers, with platinum chemo +/- bevacizumab) in June 2025 based on Phase 3 COMPASSION-16 (PFS and OS met, benefit also in PD-L1 CPS<1), the third China indication after 2L cervical (2022) and 1L gastric (2024). Dec 2025: FDA cleared global Phase 3 COMPASSION-37 (1L gastric, vs chemo +/- nivolumab); Aug 2025: NMPA/FDA cleared global registrational COMPASSION-36 (cadonilimab + lenvatinib in PD-1-resistant HCC).
first_in_class_note: First-in-class PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific and the first approved dual immune checkpoint bispecific antibody (China, June 2022).
notes: asset_key 'candonilimab' is a misspelling of cadonilimab (AK104) used in investigator-initiated trial records. Global rights retained by Akeso.

target: EGFR (classical, T790M, exon 20 insertion and PACC mutations)
mechanism: third-generation brain-penetrant mutation-selective EGFR TKI
indications: EGFR-mutant NSCLC (1L and 2L T790M)|EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC|EGFR PACC-mutant NSCLC|NSCLC with leptomeningeal metastases|neoadjuvant EGFR-mutant NSCLC
latest_data: Global Phase 3 FURVENT (1L EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC, firmonertinib vs chemo; run jointly with Allist) completed enrollment in Q1 2025 with topline monotherapy data guided for mid-2026 (ArriVent 8-K, Mar 2026); FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for 1L ex20ins NSCLC; global Phase 3 ALPACCA in 1L EGFR PACC-mutant NSCLC has dosed first patient. Approved in China (Ivesa) for EGFR T790M+ NSCLC (2021) and 1L EGFR-mutant NSCLC (2022).
first_in_class_note: Positioned as potential first oral TKI for 1L EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC (FDA BTD, Orphan Drug).
notes: Ex-China rights licensed to ArriVent BioPharma (US) in 2021; trials in this batch include investigator-initiated China studies (e.g., combination with ABSK043).

mechanism: selective PDE4B inhibitor (anti-inflammatory / anti-fibrotic)
indications: idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis|progressive pulmonary fibrosis|atopic dermatitis|plaque psoriasis|Behcet's disease
latest_data: Phase 2 in IPF (NCT06764862) completed around March 2026 (results not yet public in sources found); Phase 3 studies in IPF (NCT07519070) and progressive pulmonary fibrosis (NCT07503587) registered in 2026 plus long-term extension NCT07019090; Phase 2 studies in atopic dermatitis, psoriasis and Behcet's disease registered.
first_in_class_note: Fast-follower to nerandomilast (PDE4B) in fibrosing ILD.
notes: Highest phase 'phase 3' reflects registered Phase 3 studies not yet recruiting at last check.

mechanism: 2+2 BCMA/CD3 T-cell engager (FIT-Ig format) for plasma-cell depletion
indications: rheumatoid arthritis|IgA nephropathy|systemic sclerosis|myasthenia gravis|systemic lupus erythematosus|ulcerative colitis|relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (earlier)
latest_data: ASH 2024: Phase 1 of EMB-06 in R/R multiple myeloma showed clinical activity with minimal cytokine release. ACR 2025 abstract described preclinical-to-clinical translation for autoimmune disease; Candid reports >100 patients treated across myeloma and autoimmune indications with studies in >10 autoimmune indications (2025-2026), positioning cizutamig as potential best-in-class BCMA TCE for autoimmunity.
first_in_class_note: Positioned as potential best-in-class BCMA T-cell engager for autoimmune diseases.
notes: Originated by EpimAb (Shanghai) as EMB-06; global autoimmune rights held by Candid Therapeutics (San Diego; formed Sept 2024 by acquiring Vignette Bio, which had licensed EMB-06). The autoimmune trials in this batch are sponsored by Candid (US), so classify as non-CN if the pipeline keys on current sponsor rather than originator.

indications: echocardiography contrast|contrast-enhanced ultrasound imaging (oncology and vascular imaging studies)
notes: Seed 'Shanghai Fosun' is wrong: Definity is a Lantheus (US) product; the trials are investigator-initiated imaging studies using the marketed agent. Also approved by China NMPA per Lantheus.

latest_data: No recent efficacy data found; Phase 1 studies in R/R mature B-cell neoplasms (NCT03664297) and healthy volunteers completed, and a randomized Phase 2 in NMOSD was registered. Synapse lists global highest status as Phase 2.
notes: Ex-China rights were licensed to TG Therapeutics (TG-1701) in 2018; TG deprioritized the program around 2022 and current rights status is unclear. Several trials show 'unknown' status on CT.gov.

mechanism: dual-targeted siRNA in polypeptide nanoparticle (intralesional/local injection)
indications: cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma in situ|basal cell carcinoma|hypertrophic scar|keloid|liver cancer / cholangiocarcinoma (systemic)|localized fat reduction
latest_data: Phase 2a in isSCC (n=25, 10-120 ug dose cohorts; Nov 2020): histological complete clearance at higher doses with knockdown of TGF-beta1/COX-2 and cancer biomarkers (Ki67, NF-kB, beta-catenin). Feb 2022 interim Phase 2 in basal cell carcinoma: complete response in all patients at the high dose. No newer clinical data found.
first_in_class_note: Claimed as first RNAi therapeutic with a positive Phase 2a in oncology.
notes: Sirnaomics is HKEX-listed (2257.HK), Chinese-founded, with major R&D/manufacturing in Suzhou and Guangzhou but a US corporate base in Gaithersburg, MD, hence medium confidence on CN classification. Company faced financial distress in 2024-2025; program status unclear. INN 'cotsiranib' from memory, verify.
